title: Architecture in space
source: Wikipedia - List of topics in space
executive_summary: Space architecture is the theory and practice of designing and building inhabited environments in outer space. It borrows from multiple forms of niche architecture to accomplish the task of ensuring human beings can live and work in space.
image_caption: Historical illustration of Architecture in space in outer space.
